description: MANAGEMENT data class. Read the existing budget-or-prior variance report for a month; it never recalculates it. Amounts are decimal strings; a null actual or variance means unavailable, never zero. Rows view has whole-report unfiltered rollups and no cross-side grand total; filters affect only rows and filtered grain counts. Explanations view withholds internal notes and may redact structured PII. Filter lines or centres before paging; the signed page_token is source-pinned, so restart at page 1 if source_changed.

page_token.description: Signed continuation from the prior page; restart without it if source_changed.

name: get_variance_report
title: Read variance report
